comparison.objective: Transfer a loaded tray from temporary hand-and-rest support to a receiving shelf before withdrawing support.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual load support transfer while retaining two tins in the tray.
comparison.success_condition: Tray and contents reach the receiving shelf and the supporting hand withdraws; the body provides no complete numeric scorer.
comparison.reason: Continuous load-support transfer differs from fine tool engagement, collar adjustment, lock preservation, and damper cycling.
